articles.title: FNB (FNB) Q3 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
articles.summary: Motley Fool: FNB (FNB) Q3 2025 Earnings Call Transcript. Joining me today are Vince Calabrese, our Chief Financial Officer; and Gary Guerrieri, our Chief Credit Officer. Operating pre-provision net revenue increased 18% from the year ago quarter, contributing to positive operating leverage and a peer-leading efficiency ratio at 52%. F.N.B. produced another quarter of record revenue totaling $457 million with strong contributions from fee-based businesses, most notably in capital markets and mortgage banking, driving total noninterest income to a record $98.2 million.
